description: Exercise Raycast's Clipboard History power features. Steps: (1) Copy these three strings to the clipboard one at a time so each appears as a separate entry in Raycast's Clipboard History: 'alpha', then 'beta', then 'gamma'. (2) Open Raycast's Clipboard History and PIN the 'beta' entry (Cmd+Shift+P). (3) Open a fresh TextEdit plain-text document. (4) Use Raycast's 'Paste Sequentially' command to paste all three clipboard entries one after another into the TextEdit document, in the original order so the document reads 'alpha\nbeta\ngamma'. (5) Save the TextEdit document to ~/Desktop/clipboard_test.txt (plain text). (6) From Raycast's Clipboard History, use the 'Save as Snippet' action on the 'beta' entry to create a Raycast Snippet with keyword '!greek' and snippet text 'beta'. (7) Export your Raycast snippets to ~/Desktop/snippets.raycastsnippets.
